doc.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Any particular horn players that you enjoyed working with, sax or brass players that really stuck out.

Chuck Mangione sat in with us a couple of times. Oh well of course Doc Severinsen, I played with him. He plays. He’s great. That I would say on trumpet. And I’m trying to think of anyone else that — named that we worked with. There are more, I just can’t think right now.
